A character-level GPT exploring the rhythms and imagery of classical Chinese poetry, trained on Tang poems and a selection of five-character Song poems.

My part
I implemented six required functions in the course-provided framework, trained the model, and compared model capacity, training data and decoding settings.

    The sample’s Python sentiment result

    0.844 · Positive

    VADER compound score for the unchanged story, computed with vaderSentiment 3.3.2. It is a lexicon-based estimate, not a judgment about the story’s meaning.

    Positive 7.2% · Neutral 88.4% · Negative 4.3%. These are VADER component proportions, not confidence scores.

    POS-based lexical density is available in the Python version; its English tagger must be installed. No LD estimate is substituted here.

    Why I made TextBuddy

    I wanted to spend less time calculating text statistics and more time exploring language. TextBuddy brings text collection, analysis and report writing into a single Python workflow.

    Batch text filesWebpage extractionPOS-based lexical densityVADER sentimentWord cloudsWord & Excel reports

    Built with Python, pandas, BeautifulSoup, NLTK and VADER. The downloadable version includes the short story, setup instructions and the full report workflow.

    This browser demo runs locally: your text is not uploaded. It uses lowercase English word tokens, preserves internal apostrophes, splits hyphenated words, and excludes numbers. Frequency cards use a compact stopword list; the Python version uses NLTK’s list. LD and live sentiment analysis are not part of the browser demo.

    AIH5571 · Chinese Herbal Culture Carnival · In development

    A Journey into the Mystic Valley

    A little valley, a basket of discoveries.

    A gentle exploration game in our five-person Chinese Herbal Culture Carnival project. Designed for curious beginners, it turns an introduction to herbal culture into a small journey of observation, collection and discovery.

    A glimpse of the valley

    The valley is in daylight.

    The adventure we’re building

    1. WanderRoll a virtual die and travel one to six steps through the valley.
    2. DiscoverRead bilingual material cards and collect towards a taught target.
    3. Try & learnChoose from predefined preparation options and learn through rule-based feedback.
    4. ReflectConsider how different materials and their relationships connect to nature and care.

    Planned as a three-to-four-minute activity, with a four-material basket as a game rule and a guided fallback to keep the journey moving. This page is a visual preview; the full game is still being built.

    My part

    Game lead: interactive game design and development, including the mechanics, AI-generated visuals and integration of Chinese herbal culture knowledge.

    A cultural learning experience, with reviewed educational examples—not diagnosis or personalised prescriptions.

    Still gathering herbs and untangling code…
    The full adventure is brewing. Stay tuned!
